expected_results: ingest_event_signing.verify_ingest_event accepts ONLY a synthetic-key Ed25519 event signed by a PINNED, event-only public key that binds exactly to owner/#46->#48/INGEST/authorized-window(not_after)/expiry/nonce/payload; fails closed on malformed, bad alg/protocol, unknown/revoked key_id (unknown_key_id), wrong-key or tampered signature (bad_signature), tampered payload (payload_digest_mismatch), purpose/route/tenant mismatch, no/mismatched/expired authorized window, stale/future/expired/over-TTL event, an event that would outlive its window, over-long nonce and replay; the signing input is DOMAIN-separated so a non-domain (window-open-style) signature over the same fields is rejected; the default COPIER_INGEST_EVENT_TRUST registry is EMPTY (DARK).

ingest_envelope_dispatch.verify_ingest_envelope selects the algorithm ONCE from the declared alg: an Ed25519 failure NEVER invokes the HMAC verifier; a legacy HMAC/no-alg envelope verifies byte-for-byte as a direct verify_ingest_request while copier_ingest_hmac_legacy_enabled (default ON); an unknown alg and a disabled legacy path both fail closed without calling the other verifier.

durable_nonce: DurableNonceStore / durable_ingest_event_nonce_burn are single-use across a simulated restart (fresh instance, same CopierIngestNonce rows) AND across real concurrent threads (exactly one winner on the UNIQUE insert); a persistence fault fails closed (treated as replay); the stored token is value-blind (raw nonce never stored) and fits varchar(80); domains/scopes do not collide. The ADR-0129 window-open authorization is DURABLY single-use across a restart when given durable_window_open_nonce_store().

No schema change (makemigrations produces nothing); manage.py check clean; no secret added; Copy-Trading event signing separate from window-open and TIM signing; production endpoint behaviour byte-identical to ADR-0074 (HMAC legacy preserved, Ed25519 path DARK and unwired).

limitations: Repository-only. Auto-merge OFF; NOT merged, NOT deployed. The Ed25519 INGEST-event verification is a built+tested CONTRACT: no host emitter signs Ed25519 (the bridge still signs HMAC), and the live endpoint (event_ingestion_api.SignedEventIngestView) still calls verify_ingest_request directly, so the Ed25519 path is reachable only in tests until a separate endpoint-wiring step routes through verify_ingest_envelope.

The production COPIER_INGEST_EVENT_TRUST registry is EMPTY (DARK) and COPIER_INGEST_EVENT_VERIFICATION_ENABLED is OFF; pinning a real public key, enabling the flag, and disabling the HMAC legacy path are separate Sponsor-gated steps.
No schema change: the durable replay guard reuses CopierIngestNonce. A future packet wanting per-domain retention would add a dedicated table with documented migration/compatibility/rollback.

Unchanged and still UNPROVISIONED (ADR-0129 host rollout): the host verifier-window opener and the signed read-only #48 admission reader. The live #46->#48 demonstration remains a separate, head/runtime-pinned Sponsor real-money GO.
Ed25519 verification uses the backend cryptography library; the TIM stdlib verify-only module is untouched and un-imported, preserving identity/domain separation.
